item.title: Geisinger to Open New ConvenientCare in Southern Schuylkill County
item.description: Geisinger will open a new ConvenientCare clinic in Schuylkill County on April 1, expanding access to walk-in medical services for residents in the area. The new clinic will be located inside Geisinger’s Orwigsburg office building at 300 Hollywood Blvd. The ConvenientCare site will be staffed by two certified registered nurse practitioners (CRNPs) along with licensed medical staff. item.title: SEDCO Awarded $3.1 Million to Prepare Highridge Business Park Site for Development
item.description: The Schuylkill Economic Development Corporation (SEDCO) has been awarded more than $3.1 million in state funding to advance development of a parcel in the Highridge Business Park in Foster Township. The funding was announced as part of more than $14.5 million awarded to projects in Luzerne and Schuylkill counties through the Pennsylvania Strategic Investments to Enhance Sites Program (PA SITES).
